title: 第122章 墓园官司
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

至于挑选东西一类的,宗皇后也会时不时问太子妃的意见。

这点细节自然逃不过众人的眼，也是叫她们心里诧异极了。没想到一个毫无根基的商贾女子居然在皇家的众人里活得风生水起，游刃有余！

这下，原先私下轻看这位太子妃的,现在再看向她时,觉得这女子是满身的不简单,深不可测。

不过落云自己倒是没有这等感觉,韩瑶跟她学别的夫人评价时，落云自己都先笑开了：“我哪有她们说得那样邪乎，再说你又不是不知我有什么本事,不过是躲在你皇兄的身后狐假虎威罢了。”

韩瑶一边摆弄着她带来的虎头鞋和拨浪鼓一类的玩具，一边轻快道：“我听了也想笑，她们是不了解嫂嫂的为人,只会瞎猜测……不过我听说,那方二最近又背着她父亲回了京城，还去允孝王府去闹着见儿子,要将小世子给抱回去呢。

也许是在韩临风那里受挫，所以方锦书的母爱似乎回来一些,一顿哭闹，弄得允孝王爷也不好收场。

他明明是受了太上皇的嘱托，代为照料小皇子，结果被方二这么一闹，倒像他抢人孩子，害得人家母子分离一般。最后没有法子,那孩子到底还是让方二给抱回去了。

不过这事儿,太上皇也管顾不得了,他这几日已经油盐不进,太监喂了了许久，才能勉强灌进些汤汁。

岁数大些的都懂，太上皇这是寿数到了。所以这几日陛下都是带着几个重臣在太上皇的榻前亲自侍奉。

这除了晚辈尽孝的情分之外，韩毅这么做也是给群臣看的。

毕竟他不是太上皇的直系子孙，又是禅让得了皇位，若是任着太上皇无声无息地咽气，传出去好说不好听。

可是现在他衣带不解，蓬头垢面，早朝都不上了，带着群臣这么一守着，太上皇的三餐饮食众人都能看见。

这寿数到了，到时驾崩了，也算走得明明白白。

就这样，太上皇的寝室内外阵阵抽泣声里，自退位后一直郁郁寡欢的太上皇终于咽下了最后一口气。

伴着太监高呼的一声“太上皇崩！”那原本小声的抽噎顿时变成哀嚎一片，整个大魏进入丧期，为太上皇守孝三月，禁止婚娶，禁止丝竹享乐。

不过与此同时，民间不知为何，还是谣传起了韩毅父子窃国谋害太上皇的流言蜚语。

这本就是没根的无稽之谈，可是因为陛下最近推行的均田新政，又查出了不少以前少报私田的豪绅，罚没了不少土地，连带着还有一些给新法下绊子的人锒铛入狱。

这一时间，新皇父子在朝中得罪了诸多权贵，这类说法居然如暗火添柴，愈演愈烈，一时间演绎出许多版本来。

只是这种谣传，没根没据，也不好追究，若真是抓人来问罪，倒更像是欲盖弥彰。

韩毅也知道，身居上位者做大事立伟业，怎么可能不招惹些骂名？眼下最关键就是要让无田的农民得地，让国库丰盈起来。

老百姓们只要身上有衣，碗里有饭，可以好好地养着妻儿父母，哪里会管宫闱里的秘史？

那些谣言，就是有人妄图蝼蚁撼树，做些小手脚罢了。

但是太上皇驾崩，也得入土为安，就在商议出殡的规格时，按照韩毅的意思，不能太寒酸，但也不能完全照搬了魏惠帝生前给自己制定的丧礼规格。

这位太上皇可是生前坟圈子修得上瘾，光是疑冢就修了好几座，至于身后的殡葬礼仪陪葬规定更是事无巨细。

只是这么宏伟的入土仪式都是需要烧银子的。

当韩毅看到礼部呈送上那估算的钱数，立刻摆了摆手，这钱银的数目太多了！等埋了太上皇，大魏子民全要不吃不喝了。

他二儿子之前的婚礼都是一切从简，甚至不及豪绅的架势。现在缩减太上皇的葬礼，本也合情合理。

可是这下子，又有些找茬的老臣开始在大殿哭丧，因为陛下要葬礼从简的事情，口口声声喊着太上皇死不瞑目，自己的遗言都不得人安排。

是他们这些老臣无能，恳请陛下赐死，让他们随了太上皇去吧。

这群老东西是倚老卖老的个中翘楚，也不说太上皇生平的奢靡，只说他老人家不该这么早走，撇下大魏子民，让他们这些忠心耿耿之臣该何去何从。

坐在高堂上的皇帝韩毅全程脸儿都是黑的。

老东西们一个个都是骨头上支着松散的皮囊，高声骂他们，都怕不小心震死一个，这些人又都是有些功勋的活字老招牌，一个个苟延残喘，弄死了也没什么好处，真是当皇帝的都招惹不起。

毕竟在太上皇尸骨未寒时，再传出诛杀老臣的事情来，韩毅跟篡权夺位的奸佞何异？

可若是听从了他们，大肆操办丧礼，国库实在拿不出钱来，总不能挪用了国计民生的银两吧？

就连两个儿子带着媳妇陪着父皇用膳的时候，这韩毅的心气都没有顺过来。

落云听了却不觉得这是愁事，她只做闲话道：“这搁在民间，老人的丧礼也不好从简，不然儿女会被骂不孝。不过也不是谁家都能办得体体面面的，但是穷人也自有法子。我记得自己在乡下闲居那两年，村里就有户穷秀才死了老娘，苦于家里钱银不够，只能厚着脸皮挨家敲门，让乡里提前随了份子钱，凑在一起买了口薄棺，筹备了葬礼……”

话到这，韩毅和韩临风都是一顿，互相看了一眼。

而刚刚新婚的韩逍听了却一皱眉：“你说的那法子，都是穷酸人家的路数，如今太上皇葬礼，我父皇还能跟人要份子钱？”

韩临风缓缓道：“这有什么不可？如今国库空虚，的确需要群臣出些力气啊……”

韩毅也心领神会，眉头一松道：“那么此事，朕就交给你来办了。”

Page (1/3)

As for choosing things, Empress Zong would also ask the Crown Princess for her opinion from time to time.

Naturally, this detail could not escape everyone's eyes, and it also made them extremely surprised.Unexpectedly, a businesswoman with no foundation could actually live a prosperous and comfortable life among the royal family!

Now, when I looked down at the Crown Princess in private, I felt that this woman was full of extraordinary and unfathomable things.

However, Luo Yun himself did not feel this way. When Han Yao imitated other ladies' comments to her, Luo Yun himself laughed out loud: "I am not as evil as they say. Besides, it's not like you don't know what I am capable of. You are just hiding behind your imperial brother and pretending to be powerful."

Han Yao played with the toys such as tiger-head shoes and rattles she brought, and said briskly: "I wanted to laugh after hearing this. They don't understand the character of their sister-in-law and can only make blind guesses... But I heard that Fang Er recently returned to the capital with her father on her back, and even went to Prince Yunxiao's palace to see her son and take the young prince back.

Perhaps due to frustration with Han Linfeng, Fang Jinshu's motherly love seemed to have returned a little, and he started crying and making a fuss, which also ended badly for Prince Yunxiao.

He was obviously entrusted by the Supreme Emperor to take care of the little prince on his behalf, but Fang Er made such a fuss, it was as if he had robbed someone's child and caused the mother and child to be separated.In the end, there was no other way, so Fang Er let Fang Er take the child back.

However, the Supreme Emperor couldn't care less about this matter. He had been unable to take in food and salt for the past few days. The eunuch fed him for a long time before he could barely get in some soup.

Those who are older will understand that the Supreme Emperor has reached his end of life.Therefore, in the past few days, His Majesty has been personally serving the Supreme Emperor with several important ministers in front of his bed.

In addition to the filial piety of the younger generation, Han Yi also did this to show to the officials.

After all, he was not a direct descendant of the Supreme Emperor, and he obtained the throne through abdication. If the Supreme Emperor was allowed to die silently, the news would be publicized or not.

But now he is untidy, disheveled, and has not gone to court in the morning. With his ministers guarding him like this, everyone can see the Emperor's three meals.

This life span has come to an end, and if he dies at that time, his death will be clear.

In this way, amid bursts of sobs inside and outside the Emperor's chamber, the Emperor, who had been depressed since his abdication, finally breathed his last breath.

Accompanied by the eunuch shouting "The Emperor is dead!""The soft sobs suddenly turned into wails, and the entire Wei Dynasty entered the period of mourning, observing mourning for the Supreme Emperor for three months, prohibiting marriage, and prohibiting silk and bamboo enjoyment.

But at the same time, for some unknown reason, rumors spread among the people that Han Yi and his son were stealing the country and murdering the emperor.

This is baseless nonsense, but due to the new land equalization policy recently implemented by His Majesty, many wealthy gentry who previously underreported their private land have been identified, a lot of land has been fined and confiscated, and some people who have caused obstacles to the new law have been imprisoned.

At this time, the new emperor and his son had offended many powerful people in the court. This kind of argument actually became more and more intense, and many versions were produced for a while.

It's just that this kind of rumor has no basis and is difficult to investigate. If someone is really arrested to question the crime, it would be more like covering up the truth.

Han Yi also knew that when a person in a position of power does great things and achieves great deeds, how can he not attract some infamy?The most important thing now is to let landless farmers get land and enrich the national treasury.

As long as the common people have clothes on their backs, food in their bowls, and can properly support their wives, children, and parents, how can they care about the secret history of the palace?

Those rumors are just some people trying to shake the tree with ants and do some tricks.

However, after the death of the Supreme Emperor, he had to be buried in peace. When discussing the funeral specifications, according to Han Yi, it should not be too shabby, but it could not completely copy the funeral specifications that Emperor Wei Hui had set for himself during his lifetime.

The Supreme Emperor was addicted to the construction of tombs during his lifetime. He built several tombs alone. As for the funeral and burial regulations after his death, the regulations were even more detailed.

It's just that such a grand burial ceremony requires the burning of silver.

When Han Yi saw the estimated amount of money presented by the Ministry of Rites, he immediately waved his hand. This was too much money!After the Supreme Emperor is buried, the people of Wei will no longer have anything to eat or drink.

His second son's previous weddings were all simple, not even as elegant as those of a wealthy gentleman.It is reasonable to curtail the funeral of the Supreme Emperor now.

But now, some old ministers who were looking for trouble began to mourn in the main hall, because His Majesty wanted a simple funeral. They kept shouting that the Supreme Emperor would not die in peace, and his last words were not allowed to be arranged.

It is these old ministers who are incompetent. I beg your Majesty to grant death and let them follow the Supreme Emperor.

These old people are the best among those who rely on their old age to sell their old age. They do not talk about the extravagance of the Supreme Emperor in his life. They only say that the old man should not leave so early and leave the people of the Wei Dynasty to where they, the loyal ministers, should go.

Emperor Han Yi, who was sitting in the high hall, had a dark face the whole time.

The old guys all had loose skins on their bones, and they were scolding them loudly, fearing that one of them would be accidentally killed. These people were all old movable type signboards with some meritorious deeds, and they were all just hanging on. There would be no good if they were killed. The emperor really couldn't afford to offend him.

After all, when the Supreme Emperor's body was still cold, and there was news of killing an old minister, how could Han Yi be any different from a traitor who usurped power?

But if you listen to them and organize funerals in a big way, the national treasury really can't come up with the money, so you can't misappropriate money from the national economy and people's livelihood, right?

Even when his two sons and their wives ate with their father, Han Yi's mood was not at ease.

After hearing this, Luoyun didn't think it was a matter of sorrow. She just gossiped and said, "Leave it among the people. It's hard to keep funerals for old people simple, otherwise their children will be scolded for being unfilial.However, not everyone can manage it decently, but poor people also have their own methods.I remember that during the two years when I was living in the countryside, a poor scholar in the village died. His mother suffered from lack of money at home, so he had no choice but to knock on the door shamelessly and let the villagers take the money in advance. They got together to buy a thin coffin and prepared for the funeral..."

At this point, Han Yi and Han Linfeng both paused and looked at each other.

Han Xiao, who had just been married, frowned when he heard this: "The methods you mentioned are all used by poor people. Now that the Supreme Emperor's funeral is going on, can my father still ask for a share of the money?"

Han Linfeng said slowly: "What's wrong with this?Now that the national treasury is empty, we really need some efforts from the ministers..."

Han Yi also understood and relaxed his brows: "Then I will leave this matter to you."
